component.name: VCD Player
component.summary: Play Video CD disc images with their menus
Riproduci le immagini dei Video CD con i loro menu

description.p: A player for Video CD disc images (.cue/.bin) that behaves like a hardware VCD player: it follows the disc's own menus (PBC, Playback Control), so you pick items with the number keys of an on-screen remote control.

ul.li: Full PBC menu navigation, or plain track-by-track playback
Chapter list, resume where you left off, recent discs
Karaoke channel selection (vocals on or off)
Optional GPU upscaling shaders for the low-resolution video
